summary: The names and order of those who help to build the walls and gates of Jerusalem are listed.
meta_description: The names and order of those who help to build the walls and gates of Jerusalem are listed.

footnotes.note3_a: Probably a northwestern gate, with access to the merchants’ quarter; perhaps where Damascus gate now is. Neh. 12:39.
footnotes.note7_a: IE on the west side of the Euphrates.
footnotes.note25_a: OR the upper tower that stands out from the king’s house.
footnotes.note28_a: Probably at southeast corner of temple area. Jer. 31:39.
footnotes.note29_a: Probably the area of the “Golden Gate.”
footnotes.note31_a: OR to the upper chamber of the corner.
